const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"REPAIR_TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/repair-w61-validate.XXXXXX)
export REPAIR_TMP
for locale_file in mod-tome.lua tome-ashes-urhrok.lua tome-cults.lua
do
  env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" tools/lua/load_locale.lua ".ai/task/repair-w61-20261001/baseline/$locale_file" "$REPAIR_TMP/baseline-$locale_file.jsonl"
  env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" tools/lua/load_locale.lua "$locale_file" "$REPAIR_TMP/current-$locale_file.jsonl"
done
python3 - "$REPAIR_TMP" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
files = ("mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua")
target_changes = []
args_changes = []
for name in files:
    def load(prefix):
        return [json.loads(line) for line in (root / f"{prefix}-{name}.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    before, after = load("baseline"), load("current")
    assert len(before) == len(after), (name, len(before), len(after))
    for index, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(before, after), 1):
        old = dict(old); new = dict(new)
        old.pop("line", None); new.pop("line", None)
        old_target, new_target = old.pop("target", None), new.pop("target", None)
        old_args, new_args = old.pop("args_order", None), new.pop("args_order", None)
        assert old == new, (name, index, old, new)
        if old_target != new_target:
            target_changes.append((name, new.get("section"), new.get("source")))
        if old_args != new_args:
            args_changes.append((name, new.get("section"), new.get("source"), old_args, new_args))
    print(f"LOAD_OK {name}: records={len(after)}")
print(f"TARGET_CHANGES={len(target_changes)}")
print(f"ARGS_ORDER_CHANGES={len(args_changes)}")
assert len(target_changes) == 22, len(target_changes)
assert len(args_changes) == 4, len(args_changes)
expected_args_sources = {
    "%s the level %d %s %s was %s to death by %s%s%s on level %s of %s.",
    "%s(%d %s %s) was %s to death by %s%s on %s %s.",
    "%s the level %d %s %s %s on level %s of %s.",
    "%s(%d %s %s) %s on %s %s.",
}
assert {x[2] for x in args_changes} == expected_args_sources
print("SEMANTIC_INVARIANTS_OK: non-target/non-args_order runtime fields unchanged")
PY","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":6000});
text(r.output);
